title: The merge tool's pre-push step runs the whole checks job, not only its lint part
why: Batch 71's integration PR #2506 went red in CI on a test the batch runner never ran locally, which cost a drop and a rebuild.
note: Incident (coordinator 02:33 CST Nov 10): runner 8 ran only the lint part of the checks job before pushing batch 71; #2506 went red on test_shared_names case (g), a literal tag copy in #1538. Runner 8 dropped #1538 and rebuilt batch-71b (#2507, 11 lanes). The runner's own fix: run `bin/ci-job checks` in full before each push. Guard: the merge tool's pre-push step runs the whole checks job. Tension: the full job already passes the 1200 s lane-lint cap (step lane-lint-cap, doing), so the batch pre-push run needs its own budget or that step's speed-up first. Related, done: batch-local-checks-match-ci.
